svg.text: Output-stationary, 16x16 PEs, K = 32, 3 tiles back to back
A[0,0] meets B[0,0] at PE(0,0): the first product
PE(0,0)'s result leaves the north edge for the L1 result buffer
tile 2 follows tile 1 with no bubble
tile 3 follows tile 2 with no bubble
colour: the k meeting at each PE (one colour per wavefront); dots: results moving north
